topics.title: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with AI-made GIFs
topics.why: Turning a prompt or photo into an animated GIF is now one click in ChatGPT and Codex, with image generation 50% faster — a real jump for anyone leaning on AI for content work.

topics.title: Anthropic's IPO valuation just got cut to $1.5T
topics.why: Reuters reports investors at Anthropic's roadshow this week are pricing the company at $1.5T, down from the $2T previously floated — a reality check for anyone betting on the AI boom's momentum.

topics.title: Goldman Sachs just pulled Claude Code from traders and bankers
topics.why: Bloomberg reports Goldman now locks Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to engineers only — a sign that even Wall Street's biggest AI adopters are getting nervous about who gets to use it.
